title: Venue Rental Checklist
subtitle: Capture event date, space hold, occupancy, and setup window; confirm outside vendor and venue return.
description: Venue Rental records event date, space hold, occupancy, setup window, outside vendor, and venue return. Venue Rental evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this venue rental stage-gated verification when staff must document event date and space hold. Reconcile occupancy, setup window, outside vendor, and venue return before the venue rental handoff. Use the space-hold record, floorplan, occupancy source, vendor list, access schedule, condition photos, key log, post-event inspection, and damage or deposit disposition. Ask the assigned venue rental reviewer to confirm event date against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Venue Rental starting details
sections.guidance: Record event date, held spaces, occupancy, setup and strike windows, outside vendors, access keys, noise or use limits, condition evidence, and venue return.

sections.title: Venue Rental checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current venue rental facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Venue Rental required checks
items: Event date is identified for this record
Space hold matches the current request or source
Occupancy is ready for point-of-use staff
Setup window limits or questions are resolved
Outside vendor is communicated to the responsible person
Venue return is confirmed at handoff
A changed venue rental fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Venue Rental failed or pending items

sections.title: Venue Rental readiness
sections.guidance: Hold venue rental readiness on any failed or pending item.

fields.label: Service lead or responsible manager and date

blocks.guidance: Venue Rental receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
